findings.cause: The skin box is 1.03 x 0.89 and has square corners. Its edges and corners spill past the round belly outline in the top silhouette, which shows spill of 19%, the worst on this unit.
findings.fix: Shrink pelvis#2 in z (about 0.85) so the belly box stops spilling at the front and back edges.

findings.cause: The club shaft and brass head (forearm.R#2/#3) sit at z -0.53, which is behind the body. That puts the club in the top-left corner and causes the worst red piece (x -0.83..-0.56). In the sheet the club is held in front of the body at the fist.
findings.fix: Move forearm.R#2 and forearm.R#3 forward (+z about 0.2) so the club sits in front of the body at the hand.

findings.cause: The big fists at the lower corners of the sheet are not covered. The forearm frustums are too small and sit behind the body (z -0.32).
findings.fix: Increase the forearm.L#0 radius (mirrored to R) so the fists reach the sheet's outline.

findings.cause: Large green lobes on both sides are the fists and forearms, which the model does not cover. Uncovered share is 0.128, the highest of all views.
findings.fix: Use bigger fist frustums (radius x1.3) and set them slightly further out to the sides.

findings.cause: The square belly box spills at its corners (the worst red is 8% of the sheet).
The club is behind where the sheet draws it. Red sits right of the shaft and green sits left of it (worst piece x -0.27..-0.16, 6% of the sheet).
findings.fix: Move forearm.R#2 and forearm.R#3 by +z about 0.2.

findings.cause: Green around the fist and the shoulder/head rim. The arms and fists are thinner than in the sheet, so the figure reads as a narrow block.
Green below the feet. The boots in the sheet are larger and reach further down and forward.
findings.fix: Make the foot frustum slightly longer in z. This is secondary.
